gloss: to stand out, to be conspicuous

definitions.gloss: to stand out, to be noticeable

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目立|めだ}つ。

examples.english: He stands out because he's tall.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{目立|めだ}たないようにした。
examples.english: I tried not to stand out too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目立|めだ}つように⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, this brand has become noticeable among young people.

notes:
{目立|めだ}つ means to stand out or be conspicuous. It's formed from {目|め} (eye) + {立|た}つ (to stand).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Something stands out on its own

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {目立|めだ}つ{色|いろ}: conspicuous color
- {目立|めだ}たない: inconspicuous, not noticeable
- {目立|めだ}って: noticeably, conspicuously
- {目立|めだ}ちたがる: to want to stand out

EXAMPLES:
- {赤|あか}い{服|ふく}は{目立|めだ}つ: Red clothes stand out
- {傷|きず}が{目立|めだ}つ: The scratch is noticeable
- あまり{目立|めだ}たないように: so as not to stand out

RELATED:
- {目立|めだ}たない: inconspicuous
- {派手|はで}: flashy, showy
